production_safety.operational_data: No operational data mutations. Adds versioned generated preview PNG and descriptive HTML metadata for existing public documents.
production_safety.schema_migration: none: no database or storage schema changes.
external_side_effects: Push to the authorized GitHub main branch triggers Vercel automatic deployment.
Read official Next metadata documentation and GitHub deployment status; no external messages sent.

verification.evidence: Next production build and strict TypeScript completed with 36 generated pages.
5 tests passed. Raw HTML for Discordbot/Twitterbot includes title, description, absolute URL, Korean locale and PNG URL. Preview asset responds as image/png with dimensions 1200x630.
Generated card inspected for Korean glyph rendering, margins and wrapping; final card has no clipped text.

residual_risks: Vercel authentication protection can prevent crawler access even with correct metadata. Protection has not been disabled.
Previously shared URLs can retain the messaging platform cached preview until refreshed.
Canonical base follows NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL then Vercel production/deployment environment variables. Custom domain configuration is optional and described in README.
